name: Abu Dhabi Healthcare Information and Cyber Security Standard

official_sources.title: ADHICS v0.9 - Department of Health, Abu Dhabi
ADHICS Section 6 - Control Adoption, Compliance and Audit
ISO/IEC 27005:2022 - Information security risk management (methodology basis)

methodology: ADHICS Section 4 (Risk Management) mandates a documented risk-assessment methodology aligned with industry standards (ISO/IEC 27005). Entities classify information assets per Section 5, evaluate threats and vulnerabilities against each ADHICS clause, and rate likelihood x impact across confidentiality (PHI), integrity (patient-safety / data accuracy), availability (continuity of care delivery), and DOH regulatory compliance. Control adoption follows the entity's tier - Basic / Transitional / Advanced - per Section 6.1. Risks meeting Section 4.4 thresholds are reported to the Department of Health (DOH), Abu Dhabi.

scoping_inputs.label: Systems that create / receive / maintain / transmit PHI
Connected medical devices and equipment in scope
Physical facility locations (within Abu Dhabi Emirate)

likelihood.label: Rare
likelihood.definition: May occur only in exceptional circumstances (<5% per year).

likelihood.label: Unlikely
likelihood.definition: Could occur but not expected (5-25% per year).

likelihood.label: Possible
likelihood.definition: Might occur at some time (25-50% per year).

likelihood.label: Likely
likelihood.definition: Will probably occur in most circumstances (50-75% per year).

likelihood.label: Almost Certain
likelihood.definition: Expected to occur in most circumstances (>75% per year).

impact.label: Insignificant
impact.definition: Negligible — no impact on patient safety, PHI confidentiality, care delivery or DOH compliance.

impact.label: Minor
impact.definition: Limited impact contained to one team/system. No patient harm; routine recoverability.

impact.label: Moderate
impact.definition: Notable impact on a unit; possible PHI exposure or short interruption to care. DOH notification may be required.

impact.label: Major
impact.definition: Significant impact across multiple units; PHI breach probable; care delivery degraded for >1 week. DOH escalation expected.

impact.label: Severe
impact.definition: Patient safety event, large-scale PHI breach, sustained loss of care delivery, or loss of DOH licensure.

maturity.label: Non-Existent
maturity.definition: No process or control in place.

maturity.label: Initial / Ad Hoc
maturity.definition: Process exists but is informal and inconsistent.

maturity.label: Repeatable
maturity.definition: Process is documented and repeated, but not standardised across the entity.

maturity.label: Defined
maturity.definition: Process is documented, standardised, and integrated across the entity.

maturity.label: Managed
maturity.definition: Process is measured, monitored with KPIs, and controlled.

maturity.label: Optimised
maturity.definition: Process is continuously improved through monitoring, metrics, and lessons learned.

controls.title: Security Aspects of Employment and Termination
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall develop, enforce and maintain a human resources security policy covering the security aspects of employment and termination.

options: Information Systems Acquisition, Development, and Maintenance

questions.prompt: Control criteria tier the entity operates under (Basic / Transitional / Advanced)?
Which PHI/health-information asset, medical device, system or process is in scope?
Which information asset, system or process does this risk affect?
What threat could exploit this asset (e.g. ransomware, insider misuse, device tampering)?
What weakness or condition enables the threat?
What controls are currently in place (per ADHICS clause)?
Integrity impact — clinical-data accuracy / patient safety (1-5)?
Current implementation status (per ADHICS Section 6 self-assessment)?
Risk owner (CISO / Department head / DOH-licensed practitioner)?
Does this risk meet ADHICS DOH-notification thresholds (Section 4.4)?

controls.title: Background Verification Check
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall conduct background verification checks on all candidates for employment, contractors and third-party users.

controls.title: Terms and Condition of Employment
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall establish specific terms and condition of employment.

controls.title: Compliance to Organizational Policies and Procedures
controls.description: The healthcare entity management shall ensure employees, contractors and third party users adopt and apply security in accordance with established entity policies and procedures.

controls.title: Awareness and Training
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall develop new or modify existing awareness and training programs.

controls.title: Training Needs
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall identify and address skill and competency demands and gaps.

controls.title: Awareness Campaign
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall conduct periodic security awareness campaigns, based on established yearly schedules.

controls.title: Disciplinary Process
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall establish and enforce a disciplinary process for security breaches.

controls.title: Termination Responsibility
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall define responsibilities concerning information security for performing employment termination or change of employment.

controls.title: Return of Assets
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall ensure recovery of all organizational assets upon termination of employment, contract or agreement.

controls.title: Removal of Access Rights
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall remove access rights and revoke privileges of individuals upon termination of employment, contract or agreement.

controls.title: Internal Transfers and Change of Role
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall develop internal process to manage internal transfers and change of role.

controls.title: Asset Management Policy
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall develop, implement and maintain an asset management policy.

controls.title: Allocation of Assets
controls.description: Where applicable, the healthcare entity shall pay specific attention to medical equipment and devices while defining policy.

controls.title: Asset Inventory
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall have all their information assets identified, recorded and maintained through an information asset inventory.

controls.title: Asset Ownership
controls.description: Ownership for each identified assets shall be assigned to a designated role.

controls.title: Acceptable Use of Asset
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall establish and enforce rules on the acceptable use of information assets.

controls.title: Acceptable Bring Your Own Device Arrangements
controls.description: Entity management shall address risk due to the exploitation of Bring Your Own Device (BYOD).

controls.title: Information Classification
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall classify all information assets.

controls.title: Value of Information during Classification
controls.description: Information classification shall consider value of the information.

controls.title: Identification of Essential Protection
controls.description: The level of essential protection needed for an asset shall be considered while determining asset classification.

controls.title: Reclassification of Assets
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall establish process to reassess and/or change information classification.

controls.title: Interpretation of Third Party Classification Scheme
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall establish process to interpret classification schemes from third parties.

controls.title: Criteria for Automated Classification
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall establish criteria for automated classification of information.

controls.title: Asset Labelling
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall establish process to label its information assets.

controls.title: Handling Procedures
controls.description: Handling procedures shall be defined for information, consistent with their classification.

controls.title: Enforcement of Handling Procedures
controls.description: Ensure adoption and application of handling procedures while handling information.

controls.title: Management of Removable Media
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall manage removable media in accordance with the classification scheme.

controls.title: Usage of Removable Media
controls.description: Access and usage of removable media shall be controlled.

controls.title: Medical Devices Management Procedures
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall establish medical devices and equipment management procedures.

controls.title: Access Allocation for Medical Devices
controls.description: Access and privilege allocation for medical devices shall be provided to defined roles.

controls.title: Security of Information within Medical Devices
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall prevent unauthorized disclosure, modification, destruction or loss of patient health information stored on medical devices.

controls.title: Communication Facility for Medical Devices
controls.description: Healthcare facilities shall consider wired communication facility for medical devices.

controls.title: Removable Media Security
controls.description: Entity shall deploy technology solution to white list removable media.

controls.title: Removal and Movement of Information Assets
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall establish control procedures for the removal, movement, and transfer of information assets.

controls.title: Information Asset Disposal
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall dispose information assets, when no longer required.

controls.title: Secure Disposal
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall establish a control process that ensures data once destroyed is not recovered.

controls.title: Disposal of Physical & Digital Media
controls.description: Media, both digital and physical, when no longer required shall be destroyed by the entity.

controls.title: Procedures for Secure Disposal and Re-Use
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall establish control procedures for the secure disposal or reuse of media.

controls.title: Verification before Disposal
controls.description: Retention requirement of data shall be verified prior to disposal.

controls.title: Authorization for Disposal
controls.description: All disposal requirement shall be authorized by entity management prior to disposal.

controls.title: Records on Disposal
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall maintain records on media disposal.

domains.name: Domain PE - Physical and Environmental Security

controls.title: Physical and Environmental Security Policy
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall develop, implement and maintain a physical and environmental security policy.

controls.title: Procedural Guidelines
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall establish procedures and guidelines in support of policy implementation.

controls.title: Requirements on Physical and Environmental Policy
controls.description: The physical and environmental policy shall consider equipment and medical devices.

controls.title: Physical Security Perimeter
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall define and use security perimeters to protect facilities.

controls.title: Private Areas
controls.description: Allocate secure private areas to discuss personal health information.

controls.title: Secure Areas Control Measures
controls.description: Secure areas shall be protected by appropriate control measures.

controls.title: Ownership of Secure Areas
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall nominate owners for each identified secure areas.

controls.title: Secure Office/Meeting Rooms
controls.description: Offices, meeting rooms and facilities shall be equipped with adequate physical security measures.

controls.title: Protection against External & Environmental Threats
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall design and apply physical protection against natural disasters, environmental threats, external attacks and/or accidents.

controls.title: Adequacy/Effectiveness of Control Measures
controls.description: Physical and environmental countermeasures shall be aligned with risk assessment outcomes.

controls.title: Working in Secure Areas
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall design physical protection and guidelines for working in secure areas.

controls.title: Stakeholder Awareness
controls.description: Ensure all personnel accessing secure areas is aware of security requirements.

controls.title: Deliver and Loading Areas
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall have segregated delivery and loading areas.

controls.title: Equipment Siting and Protection
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall site/position equipment and medical devices in manner that they are always protected.

controls.title: Supporting Utilities
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall protect equipment and medical devices from disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities.

controls.title: Maintenance of Equipment
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall maintain supporting equipment.

controls.title: Cabling Security
controls.description: Power, telecommunication and cables carrying data shall be secured and protected.

controls.title: Security of Equipment Off Site
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall identify and apply security measures to protect equipment off-site.

controls.title: Unattended User Equipment
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall ensure that unattended equipment, medical devices and information processing systems are protected.

controls.title: Clear Desk & Clear Screen Policy
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall define and enforce a clear desk and clear screen policy.

controls.title: Access Control Policy
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall develop, enforce and maintain an access control policy.

controls.title: User Registration and De-Registration
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall implement a formal user registration and de-registration process.

controls.title: Privilege Management
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall restrict and control allocation of privileges, based on principles of need to know.

controls.title: Use and Management of Security Credential
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall establish process for secure allocation, use and management of security credentials.

controls.title: Access Control for Portable and Medical Devices
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall protect confidential and secret information on portable or removable media, mobile or portable devices, and medical equipment or devices.

controls.title: Access Control for Assets and Equipment in Teleworking Sites
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall control access to equipment, devices, system and facilities at teleworking sites.

controls.title: Review of User Access Rights
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall review access and privileges granted to its user.

controls.title: Access to Network and Network Services
controls.description: Access to the entity's network and network services shall be controlled.

controls.title: Remote User Authentication
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall use appropriate authentication methods to control access of remote users.

controls.title: Equipment Identification in Network
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall identify all equipment and devices connected to its network.

controls.title: Remote Diagnostic and Configuration Protection
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall control access for the purpose of diagnostic and configuration.

controls.title: Network Connection Control
controls.description: User access to shared and isolated networks shall be restricted.

controls.title: Network Routing Control
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall define and implement network routing controls.

controls.title: Wireless Access
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall ensure wireless access within the entity is secured.

controls.title: Secure Log-On Procedures
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall establish and enforce secure log-on and log-off procedures.

controls.title: User Identification and Authentication
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall create unique identifier (user ID) for each users.

controls.title: Use of System Utilities
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall restrict and control the use of utility programs and tools.

controls.title: Information Access Restriction
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall restrict access to information and application system functions.

controls.title: Sensitive System Isolation
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall isolate sensitive systems in a dedicated environment.

controls.title: Publicly Accessible Content
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall implement controls and shall not expose non-public information to the general public.

controls.title: Operations Management Policy
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall develop, enforce and maintain an operations management policy.

controls.title: Baseline Configuration
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall develop and enforce baseline and recommended configuration settings.

controls.title: Documented Operating Procedure
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall document operating procedures.

controls.title: Change Management
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall control changes to information systems and applications.

controls.title: Transition of Information Systems and Applications
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall establish a process that controls transition of information systems and applications.

controls.title: Segregation of Duties
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall identify and segregate roles of conflicting interests.

controls.title: Separation of Test, Development and Operational Environment
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall identify and separate development, test, staging and operational environments.

controls.title: Capacity Management
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall identify and document current and future capacity requirements.

controls.title: System Acceptance and Testing
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall establish acceptance criteria for new information systems and applications.

controls.title: Controls Against Malware

controls.title: Gateway Level Protection for Malware
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall deploy gateway level protection mechanisms.

controls.title: Backup Management
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall maintain backup copies of essential information and software.

controls.title: Archival Requirements
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall establish data archival requirements.

controls.title: Monitoring Procedures
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall establish and enforce monitoring procedures.

controls.title: Audit Logging

controls.title: Preservation of Log Information
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall preserve logs in a centralized log management system.

controls.title: Clock Synchronization
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall synchronize clock of all information systems with an agreed time source.

controls.title: Patch Management
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall define and establish formal procedure for updates and patching.

controls.title: Information Leakage

controls.title: Technical Vulnerability Assessment
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall conduct periodic independent assessment.

controls.title: Security of Assessment Data
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall ensure that assessment data is not available with third parties beyond the time of engagement.

controls.title: Communication Policy
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall develop, enforce and maintain a communications policy.

controls.title: Information Exchange Procedures
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall develop, enforce and maintain formal procedures on information exchange.

controls.title: Security of Information During Transit
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall ensure that critical and private information is protected while in transit.

controls.title: Secure Practices for Information Sharing
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall develop secure practices and capabilities while sharing information.

controls.title: Agreements on Information Transfer
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall establish agreements between the entity and external parties for the exchange of information and software.

controls.title: External Party Awareness of Security Requirements
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall ensure that external parties are aware of the security requirements.

controls.title: Physical Media in Transit
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall protect physical media containing information during transit.

controls.title: Electronic Messaging
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall protect information involved in electronic messaging.

controls.title: Business Information System
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall develop, enforce and maintain procedures to secure information transferred across business information systems.

controls.title: Security of Electronic Commerce Services
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall protect electronic commerce service and information.

controls.title: Online Transaction
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall protect information involved in online transactions.

controls.title: Publicly Available Information
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall protect information available through the publicly accessible system.

controls.title: Connectivity to Information Sharing Platforms
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall ensure that connectivity to information sharing platforms is secure and controlled.

controls.title: Restriction on Cloud Environment

controls.title: Security While Connecting to Information Sharing Platform

controls.title: Network Controls

controls.title: Security Requirements in Network Services

controls.title: Segregation in Networks

controls.title: Security of Wireless Networks

controls.title: Security of Healthcare Information

controls.title: Control of Operational Software

controls.title: Protection of System Test Data
controls.description: The healthcare entity shall protect system test data.

controls.title: Access Control to Program Source Code
